name: smwgraphics-sky-high
title: Sky High
description:
It's simply some clouds, and some ground, with grass. Easy palettes to edit, so if your not happy with the Blue/Grey dirt, you can always change it. There are no decorations, so you'll have to draw your own, or use the standard SMW ones. The clouds are all on one layer, just in-case you were thinking they were Layer 2/3.

Yep.
